guard_and_conservation.canonical: Full independent A1 coordinates, lifecycle/applicability and all simultaneous typed true reasons/evidence are preserved by A5 subject to normal retention policy. Primary is a projection, never complete truth.
guard_and_conservation.boundary: Exactly one primary_visible_disposition per admitted boundary-specific projection; boundary_id/consumer_class, principal/root refs, purpose/recipient and as_of are explicit.
guard_and_conservation.privacy: A3 exact recipient/purpose prohibition selects PRIVACY_EXCLUDED before semantic precedence. Unauthorized visible_reason_projection exposes only a privacy-safe reason, never private secondary reason/value/reference.
guard_and_conservation.authorized: Only inside a proven permitted disclosure boundary, choose the first applicable semantic disposition in the source order. All secondary canonical reasons remain true, not erased.
guard_and_conservation.permission_unknown: Do not treat unknown privacy as known permitted/prohibited. A3 fail-closed qualification blocks unauthorized disclosure; no new primary spelling is invented for an unadmitted projection.
guard_and_conservation.action: KNOWN_REQUIRED or any visible primary is not authority to act, proof of effect, or objective closure.
